description: This file is a bitbake recipe fragment defining how to build the Bash shell as part of an embedded Linux image. It includes metadata such as description, dependencies, inheritance, build steps, and installation procedures.

methods.name: do_configure
methods.description: Prepares configuration by ensuring acinclude.m4 exists by copying from aclocal.m4 if missing.

methods.name: do_compile
methods.description: Removes any leftover build files to ensure reproducibility of the build.

methods.name: do_compile_ptest
methods.description: Runs make buildtest to build the test portion of Bash.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Removes build marker to ensure reproducible install.

methods.name: do_install_ptest
methods.description: Installs test resources, copies files, and cleans build host references in files.

methods.name: pkg_postinst
methods.description: Adds bash to the system shells list if not already present.

methods.name: pkg_postrm
methods.description: Removes bash from the system shells list.
